policy: Read-only registry of 13 authoritative geospatial, package, standards, and security discovery ecosystems (REQ-EV2-025). Never auto-queries external networks or auto-installs packages.

ecosystems.name: OSGeo Foundation Projects
ecosystems.coverage: Graduated & community open-source GIS desktop, web, server, and C/C++/Java geospatial engines.
ecosystems.trust_note: Strong governance, IP provenance, and OSI-approved license oversight.

ecosystems.name: OSGeoLive Curated Distribution
ecosystems.coverage: Cross-tested Linux geospatial desktop, server, spatial DB, and crisis/navigation stack.
ecosystems.trust_note: Helpful compatibility baseline for co-existing OSS GIS packages on Linux.

ecosystems.name: GDAL / OGR & PROJ Official Drivers
ecosystems.coverage: Authoritative vector/raster format drivers, optional third-party libraries, and CRS transforms.
ecosystems.trust_note: Driver-level external library dependencies & licenses vary individually.

ecosystems.name: Curated Directories (awesome-gis, awesome-georust, gishub)
ecosystems.coverage: Cross-language open-source GIS tooling directories indexed cleanly through project-catalog.json.
ecosystems.trust_note: Directory inclusion does not verify security, build health, or redistribution rights.

ecosystems.name: PyPI (Python Package Index)
ecosystems.coverage: Python GIS bindings & libraries (rasterio, geopandas, pyproj, pyogrio, shapely, xarray, torchgeo).
ecosystems.trust_note: Distinguish wheel binary native DLL bundling vs conda-forge system libraries.

ecosystems.name: conda-forge Geospatial Feedstocks
ecosystems.coverage: ABI-harmonized C/C++/Python native builds of GDAL, PROJ, GEOS, PDAL, QGIS, GRASS across Windows/Linux/macOS.
ecosystems.trust_note: Preferred isolated environment for avoiding native Windows DLL conflicts.

ecosystems.name: npm Registry (JavaScript / TypeScript)
ecosystems.coverage: Web GIS renderers & utilities (maplibre-gl, cesium, ol, leaflet, @turf/turf, pmtiles, deck.gl).
ecosystems.trust_note: Inspect transitive dependencies & browser bundle size / WebGL support before selecting.

ecosystems.name: NuGet (.NET / Windows Desktop GIS)
ecosystems.coverage: .NET geospatial & WPF/MAUI packages (NetTopologySuite, Mapsui, ProjNet, GDAL.Native, Fluent.Ribbon).
ecosystems.trust_note: Check .NET TFM target and native runtime RID (win-x64 / arm64) separately.

ecosystems.name: crates.io (Rust Spatial Ecosystem)
ecosystems.coverage: Rust GIS libraries (geo, gdal, proj, rstar, geozero, flatgeobuf, geolibre-rust, wgpu).
ecosystems.trust_note: Verify FFI system library requirements (libgdal/libproj) vs pure-Rust implementations.

ecosystems.name: Maven Central (JVM / Android GIS)
ecosystems.coverage: Java & Android GIS artifacts (GeoTools, JTS, GraphHopper, OpenTripPlanner, MapLibre Android SDK).
ecosystems.trust_note: Mind GeoTools LGPL boundaries and Android AAR ABI splits.

ecosystems.name: OGC Standards, EPSG Registry & STAC Index
ecosystems.coverage: Authoritative spatial standards: OGC API, GeoPackage, 3D Tiles, CityGML, EPSG CRSs, and STAC catalogs.
ecosystems.trust_note: Canonical authority for CRS codes, data encodings, and interoperability schemas.

ecosystems.name: SPDX License List & Open Source Initiative (OSI)
ecosystems.coverage: Standardized SPDX identifiers, copyleft exceptions, and OSI-approved license text verification.
ecosystems.trust_note: GitHub API license_hint does not substitute for inspecting LICENSE/COPYING + dependencies.

ecosystems.name: OSV.dev, OpenSSF Scorecard, CycloneDX & GitHub Advisories
ecosystems.coverage: Vulnerability advisories, supply-chain security scorecards, and CycloneDX SBOM standards.
ecosystems.trust_note: Optional external verification tools remain NOT RUN unless explicitly invoked/authorized.
